description: Minecraft API families. Each family is one set of version-specific adapter sources (client/platform/<id>) valid for a range of Minecraft releases; differences inside a family are //#if MC blocks (tools/port-version/preprocess.py). Each loader lists build setups by Minecraft range; buildgen names tools/port-version/templates/<buildgen>; gradle_jdk is the JVM Gradle itself needs when it is newer than the game's Java (Loom 1.18 runs on Java 25+). A version is only *supported* when CI builds it (versions/build-status.json).
